name: Angel Hare's Learning Adventure
source:
Join Angel Gabby and friends on an educational journey through the skies! Will you remember how to behave well with others? Or will you need to be taught an additional lesson?

[From [url=https://ahorseforeveryseason.itch.io/angel-hare]itch.io[/url]]

Based on the "Angel Hare" web series.
translation:
与Angel Gabby和朋友们一起踏上天空教育之旅！你会记得如何与他人良好相处吗？或者你需要接受额外的课程吗？

[来自[url=https://ahorseforeveryseason.itch.io/angel-hare]itch.io[/url]]

改编自网络连续剧“天使兔”。
